authorization: Optional external walkthrough enabled explicitly with --hint-file.

4-4.assistance: External walkthrough assistance; this route is supplied to Jev rather than discovered unaided.
4-4.route: FIRST maze: UPPER corridor. SECOND maze: BOTTOM corridor. Wrong height repeats the hall. These are corridors, not pipes. Reach the axe beyond the fake Bowser.
4-4.coordinates: World pixel coordinates interpreted from the published NES map; y increases downward. Heights below refer to Mario's FEET, not his sprite top.
rules: Follow the ordered corridor route before maximizing horizontal progress. A safe action entering the wrong corridor is not progress.
The first upper floor is at feet_y=96 and starts near x=288. Keep that height across the small gaps. Do not drop to feet_y=208 in this first maze.
After passing the first maze, drop at the end of the upper floor around x=1200 and go underneath the wall around x=1232.

Climb the platforms around x=1376,1424,1488 to the high floor at x=1520. Drop through the FIRST upper-floor gap x=1568..1600, then move LEFT along the middle floor to its gap x=1520..1536. Drop to the bottom, then go RIGHT along the lowest corridor.

Second-maze correct floor is feet_y=208. Remain below the middle floor; upper and middle corridors loop. Avoid unnecessary jumps near the end of either maze: the game checks that Mario is grounded at the correct height.
Past x=2320 the maze is over. Avoid fire, pass Bowser and touch the axe. Do not stop merely on reaching the boss.

phases.goal: Maze complete: pass Bowser and touch the axe on the right.
SECOND MAZE: stay on the BOTTOM corridor at feet_y=208 and advance right. Avoid jumps unless needed for a hazard.
FIRST MAZE: reach and STAY on the UPPER corridor, feet_y=96. Prefer a landing at this height over a larger x on the bottom floor. Jump across gaps when running would drop you.
First maze passed. Continue to the end of the upper floor, drop near x=1200 and move right UNDER the wall near x=1232.
SECOND MAZE ENTRY: move LEFT to the middle-floor gap x=1520..1536 and drop to feet_y=208. Moving right on this middle floor is the wrong route.
SECOND MAZE ENTRY: align with the first upper-floor gap x=1568..1600 (Mario x about 1576) and drop WITHOUT jumping. If you passed it, move LEFT back to it.
Climb the stone platforms above the lava to the high floor near x=1520, feet_y=96. Then use the first gap in that floor to descend toward the bottom corridor.
